taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS MeF schema for Schedule 2; it lives on the parent 1040 return.

ssn.rationale: SSN is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS MeF schema for Schedule 2; it lives on the parent 1040 return.

alternative_minimum_tax.rationale: AlternativeMinimumTaxAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 1 (AMT).

excess_advance_premium_tax_credit.rationale: PremiumTaxCreditTaxLiabAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 2 for excess advance premium tax credit repayment.

part_i_total.rationale: AdditionalTaxAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 3, the total of Part I additional taxes carried to Form 1040.

self_employment_tax.rationale: SelfEmploymentTaxAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 4 (self-employment tax from Schedule SE).

unreported_social_security_medicare_tax_.rationale: UnrprtdSocSecAndMedcrTaxAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 5a for unreported SS/Medicare tax from Form 4137.
UncollectedSocSecMedTaxAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 5b for uncollected SS/Medicare tax on wages from Form 8919.

additional_tax_on_iras.rationale: TaxOnIRAsAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 6 for additional tax on IRAs and other tax-favored accounts.

household_employment_taxes.rationale: HouseholdEmploymentTaxAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 7a for household employment taxes from Schedule H.

repayment_first_time_homebuyer_credit.rationale: MortgSbsdyRecaptureTaxAmt is the closest candidate for Line 7b repayment of first-time homebuyer credit; however no exact match exists and this may be a mismatch — the canonical schema may encode this differently.

additional_medicare_tax.rationale: IndivNetInvstIncomeTaxAmt — actually, the Additional Medicare Tax (Line 8, Form 8959) best matches UncollSSMedcrRRTAGrpInsTxAmt; reassigning: UncollSSMedcrRRTAGrpInsTxAmt at idx 62 represents uncollected SS/Medicare/RRTA on group-term insurance, not Line 8. The correct match is idx 55 TotalAMRRTTaxAmt which covers Additional Medicare/RRTA tax.

net_investment_income_tax.rationale: IndivNetInvstIncomeTaxAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 9 (net investment income tax from Form 8960).

uncollected_ss_medicare_tax_on_wages.rationale: UncollSSMedcrRRTAGrpInsTxAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 10 for uncollected SS/Medicare tax on wages from W-2 box 12.

interest_on_installment_sale.rationale: IntTaxDueInstalSaleIncmAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 11 for interest on tax attributable to installment sales under IRC 453A(c)/453(l).

interest_on_tax_deferred_section_1260.rationale: IntDefrdTaxGainInstalSalesAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 12 for interest on deferred tax gain under section 1260(b).

look_back_interest_form_8697.rationale: LookBackIntSect167gOr460bAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 13 for look-back interest on long-term contracts from Form 8697.

look_back_interest_form_8866.rationale: InterestOnEachNetIncrInTaxAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 14 for look-back interest using the income forecast method from Form 8866.

alternative_tax_qualifying_shipping.rationale: IncomeNotUSBusinessTaxAmt is the closest candidate for alternative tax on qualifying shipping activities (Form 8902, Line 15); no exact name match exists.

recapture_low_income_housing_credit.rationale: RecaptureTaxAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 16 for recapture of low-income housing credit from Form 8611.

section_965_net_tax_liability.rationale: Section965TaxInstallmentAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 17a for section 965 net tax liability installment.

other_additional_taxes.rationale: OtherTaxAmt within OtherTaxAdditionsGrp corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 17z for other additional taxes not listed elsewhere.

part_ii_total.rationale: TotalOtherTaxesAmt corresponds to Schedule 2 Line 18, the total of Part II other taxes carried to Form 1040.
